evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible rule or constraint about creating games or the name/description fields.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible restriction on how estimators are invited.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: No other story conflicts with the moderator's ability to start a round with that input method.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible rule about listing session items.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible constraint on selecting items for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No story conflicts with permitting moderators to add items during a session.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other requirement imposes an incompatible rule preventing item edits.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires that items cannot be deleted; deletion is not contradicted elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: This allows revealing estimates before all estimators have given theirs, which conflicts with participant stories that require estimates be shown only after all have given (PP-033) and with stories that allow changing estimates until the last person selects and all are shown (PP-034, PP-041).

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible rule preventing accepting an average as the agreed estimate.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires a contradictory behavior; automatic filling on unanimous cards is compatible with other rules.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: No story imposes an incompatible constraint on entering agreed estimates.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimating earlier stories is not incompatible with any other story.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible rule preventing spreadsheet import.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: No conflicting constraint found; this is compatible with import and story creation features.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games is not contradicted by any requirement; deletion of games (PP-020) does not create an incompatibility because it permits deletion but doesn't forbid browsing existing ones.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Export and view transcript requirements do not conflict with each other or with deletion beyond expected behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires contradicting behavior; exporting is compatible with other features.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: No incompatible rules conflict with CSV export.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: While this removes stored games, no other story requires that games must be permanently stored; thus no direct contradiction.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible registration requirement.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login requirements do not conflict with account creation or other stories.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: No incompatible rule prevents account detail changes.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion does not contradict other stories; it simply allows removal of data.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: No other story contradicts showing local timezone information.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires an incompatible password recovery behavior.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: No story conflicts with configuring card sets; this is compatible with estimation behavior requirements.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible team size constraint.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining via URL and entering name does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: No conflicting rules prohibit showing the current item to estimators.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires hiding the session item list; this is compatible.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Showing that someone has given an estimate (status indicator) is not incompatible with requirements to reveal estimate values only after all have given (PP-033); it does not reveal estimate content.

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: This conflicts with moderator story PP-009 that allows showing all estimates immediately (even before all estimators have given theirs), imposing incompatible rules about when estimates may be revealed.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: This relies on estimates being revealed only after all have selected; PP-009's ability for a moderator to 'show all estimates immediately' is incompatible because it can reveal estimates before the last person selects, undermining this rule.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids viewing prior estimates; this is not inconsistent with any other requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible rule forbidding identification of who gave which estimates during discussion.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: No other story contradicts having a visible two-minute timer; it's compatible with other behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Automatic reset on all estimates being played is not incompatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: No story imposes an incompatible constraint preventing scrolling through prior rounds.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires a conflicting ordering behavior; this is consistent.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Draw completion can be forced by moderator action per PP-009 ('show all estimates immediately'), which is incompatible with the participant rule that they can change until completion; PP-009 and this story impose conflicting control over when the draw is completed.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: No conflicting story forbids showing a thumbnail photo near played cards.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible nonstandard markup requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: No story conflicts with maintaining a glossary or definitions list.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Performance-related developer story does not conflict with other functional requirements.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Backward-compatibility requirement is not directly incompatible with any other story.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance does not conflict with other requirements in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance expectation is compatible with other stories and not contradicted elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support does not conflict with any other requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible rule for URL structure.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: No conflicting requirement forbids friendly error pages.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Anonymizing research data does not conflict with other requirements; no other story requires identifiable storage.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Providing usage metrics is not incompatible with other backlog items.
